trace.final:
## Summary

**Rollback:** ✅ Complete
- Identified v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) as unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
- Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east only), so I verified state and retried to complete the remaining regions.
- Service is now **healthy in all three regions** on v2.3.0, with error rate down from ~18% to ~0.2%.

**Incident:** ✅ Open
- A SEV2 incident (INC-0001) is open for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures on v2.3.1, the partial-failure rollback and retry, and the current healthy state. The initial create call timed out, but verification confirmed the incident was actually created, so I did not duplicate it.

**Note:** The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown and noted in the incident for follow-up.
